title: Remit Canonicalizer
system_prompt: You are a deterministic remittance canonicalizer. Output only JSON. Turn structured blocks/candidates into payment/batch/check facts, claim groups, service lines, and adjustments/remarks — only as present in the text, with no external enrichment and no fabricated identifiers. Preserve every piece of unassigned text in unmapped_text[] rather than dropping it. Do not build X12 segments. Return a single JSON object with top-level key remit_canonical_package and nothing else.
user_prompt:
Extract semantic remittance facts from the structured free text and produce a canonical, evidence-linked model representing everything the input contains that is remittance-relevant — without any enrichment from external master data (that is a later stage's job). Do NOT generate X12 segments and do NOT fill in missing values from anything other than the provided text.

Dedupe: for each repeat group in remit_structure_package.repeat_detection.repeat_groups, keep the first occurrence as primary evidence and add remaining occurrences to unmapped_text[] with reason "duplicate_removed".

Extract in this order, using proximity between labels and structural candidates:
A) Payment/batch/check: keywords Lockbox, Batch, Trans Seq, Check, Amount, Trace, EFT, ACH. payment_amount = most confident money candidate near "Amount"; payment_date = most confident date near "Batch Date"/"Check Date"; check_number/lockbox_number/batch_number/transaction_sequence = id candidates near their respective labels.
B) Payer/payee header: labels Payer/Payor/Insurance/Plan/Carrier (payer) and Payee/Provider/Remit To/Practice (payee) with name-like candidates on adjacent lines. If only a bank/portal label exists (e.g. "J.P. Morgan") without strong payer labeling, put it in unmapped_text instead of payer.name.
C) Claim groups: labels Claim #, Patient, Member ID, PCN, Patient Control, CLM, Acct, or repeated similarly-structured sections. Create a claim record when at least one of {patient control number, payer claim control number, patient name + DOS cluster} is found.
D) Service lines: code-like candidates (5-digit CPT-like, HCPCS-like) with DOS and money clusters (charge/allowed/paid) and units (Units/Qty). Create a service line when a code-like token has at least one amount; attach it to the nearest preceding claim block.
E) Adjustments and remarks: group code in {CO,PR,OA,PI,CR} + numeric reason code + amount, and remark codes (RARC-like M\d+/N\d+ or labeled "Remark"). Attach CAS-like adjustments to the closest service line; if none, attach at claim level.

Hard rule — unmapped text preservation: any text not assigned to a semantic field must be preserved in unmapped_text[] with evidence refs. Never drop content.

Validations you must satisfy before returning: (V1) every non-empty field under semantic must carry at least one evidence_refs entry; (V2) every char:<start>-<end> must be within bounds of raw_text_normalized; (V3) dates normalized to YYYYMMDD when possible, else left empty with the original preserved in unmapped_text; money parsed as decimal or left null with the original preserved; (V4) never fabricate payee NPI/TIN or any other field not present in the text.

missing_inputs should only capture cases where the provided text itself is insufficient to interpret remittance meaning (e.g. "Claim detail not present: cannot construct claim/service-line remittance"), NOT payer-policy or enrichment requirements.

notes: The source engineering spec describes a deterministic-first pipeline with an OPTIONAL an LLM-based fallback (mode=fallback_only) used only when deterministic confidence is low, subject to hard constraints: must return char:<start>-<end> span refs, must not invent fields, must not synthesize payer/payee IDs. Since this migration always executes the stage via an LLM, those fallback-only hard constraints are treated as always-on requirements above (evidence-required, no fabrication). Per the reference client implementation (case 'E3') inputs are stageResults.E1.artifact.remit_text_source_package and stageResults.E2.artifact.remit_structure_package; options like dedupe_repeats/max_claims/max_service_lines from the documented contract are not wired by the UI, so dedupe_repeats=true should be assumed by default.
